title: ViewSettingsDialog
description: Fiori view settings dialog: sort/filter/group pages, two-level filter navigation with counters, Reset, OK/Cancel (ui5-view-settings-dialog).

usage.summary: Adjust a list or table view through sorting, grouping and predefined filter choices.
useWhen: Let users choose how a list or table is sorted without leaving its current page.
Let users select grouping criteria and predefined filter values, then confirm the combined settings.
Provide sortItems, groupItems and filterItems only for the settings the view supports.

avoidWhen.when: Personalize filter-field visibility or order and edit conditions beyond predefined filter values.
Set several criteria in a result-page header, as in a list report.
Save and switch reusable table or filter settings rather than adjust only the current view.
